reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, takes its categories from the existing getMonthBudgetCategories/shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory policy and the sign from averageToBudgetAmount.

duplication.why: Exclusion rules are added once in shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory and the per-action SQL hidden filter is removed; the goal_def column is still selected in two queries (getBudgetData and the policy) as before.

placement.why: Selection rules live in month-action-categories.ts, the module the tree designates as the shared category policy; the new action sits with the others in actions.ts and app.ts.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the policy, actions and registration, though no change addresses the #fixed group-notes exclusion of step 3.

maintainability.why: The policy stays central, but the flag is threaded positionally with an `undefined` filler for previousMonth at every call, the `action` parameter of shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory is now unused, and the #fixed rule has no place in the policy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through getMonthBudgetCategories or shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory (copyPreviousMonth, as before).

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; setLastMonthSpending composes the shared selection and sign helpers.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories added as a trailing positional parameter to both getMonthBudgetCategories and shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory in month-action-categories.ts, forcing `undefined` for previousMonth at the setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg/setLastMonthSpending call sites; the zero/average special cases were removed rather than added.
